Name: Archery - Starter Pack
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/lpZuMO6.png[/img][size=3]
Archery - Starter Pack is an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16767]Archery[/url] content pack which adds over 12 new bows and crossbows, as well as their respective ammo and recipes.

Many of the weapons in this pack have "special attacks", as well as "enchanted" ammo with custom effects. Includes a few secret weapons too!
[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/vcYxLs1.png[/img][size=3]
By default, the player will only have the "Makeshift Bow" and "Makeshift Ammo" recipe unlocked. All other weapons and ammo recipes are purchasable from [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Marlon]Marlon[/url], however most are locked behind certain mine level requirements.

Marlon will also sell the weapons and ammo, though at a higher price compared to their recipes.
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/qU1cobf.png[/img][size=3]
[spoiler][img]https://imgur.com/rZvWpqv.gif[/img]

This pack adds 6 usable bows, most of which are craftable. These use arrows as ammo.

[b][size=4]Makeshift Bow[/size][/b]
A haphazardly constructed bow made out of fiber and twigs.

The recipe is automatically known.

[b][size=4]Wooden Bow[/size][/b]
A simple bow made of wood and string.

Can be purchased from Marlon, though it is not craftable.

[b][size=4]Copper Bow[/size][/b]
A shiny copper reinforced bow.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 40 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Steel Bow[/size][/b]
A heavy steel bow that packs quite the punch.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 60 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Gold Bow[/size][/b]
A dazzling gold reinforced bow.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 80 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Iridium Bow[/size][/b]
An ultra-light bow made of material you've never seen before.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after unlocking the Galaxy Sword.
[/spoiler][/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/kmwcLDe.png[/img][size=3]
[spoiler][img]https://imgur.com/t7ezL2C.gif[/img]

This pack adds 5 usable crossbows, most of which are craftable. These use bolts as ammo.

[b][size=4]Wooden Crossbow[/size][/b]
A simple crossbow made of wood and string.

Can be purchased from Marlon, though it is not craftable.

[b][size=4]Copper Crossbow[/size][/b]
A shiny copper reinforced crossbow.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 40 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Steel Crossbow[/size][/b]
A heavy steel crossbow that packs quite the punch.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 60 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Gold Crossbow[/size][/b]
A dazzling gold reinforced crossbow.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 80 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Iridium Crossbow[/size][/b]
An ultra-light crossbow made of material you've never seen before.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after unlocking the Galaxy Sword.
[/spoiler][/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/5p8cDmA.png[/img][size=3]
[spoiler]This pack adds 19 different ammo, of which 10 are arrows and 9 bolts.

[b][size=5]Arrows[/size][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/0RPnl98.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Makeshift Arrow[/size][/b]
A simple arrow made of wood.

The recipe is automatically known.

[b][size=4]Stone Arrow[/size][/b]
A wooden arrow with stone tips.

Both the ammo and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 15 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Copper Arrow[/size][/b]
A wooden arrow with copper tips.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 40 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Steel Arrow[/size][/b]
A wooden arrow with steel tips.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 60 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Gold Arrow[/size][/b]
A wooden arrow with gold tips. These have a high chance of critical hits.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 80 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Iridium Arrow[/size][/b]
A wooden arrow with iridium tips.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after unlocking the Galaxy Sword.

[b][size=5]Bolts[/size][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/RWMbMrw.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Stone Bolt[/size][/b]
A wooden bolt with stone tips.

Both the ammo and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 15 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Copper Bolt[/size][/b]
A wooden bolt with copper tips.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 40 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Steel Bolt[/size][/b]
A wooden bolt with steel tips.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 60 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Gold Bolt[/size][/b]
A wooden bolt with gold tips. These have a high chance of critical hits.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after reaching floor 80 in the mine.

[b][size=4]Iridium Bolt[/size][/b]
A wooden bolt with iridium tips.

Both the weapon and recipe can be purchased from Marlon after unlocking the Galaxy Sword.

[b][size=5]Enchanted Arrows / Bolts[/size][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/NHnIqGx.png[/img]
These unlock automatically after purchasing the Steel Arrow / Steel Bolt recipe.

[b][size=4]Aquamarine Arrow / Bolt[/size][/b]
A steel tipped arrow / bolt with an embedded aquamarine.

Has a 50% to stun an enemy upon impact.

[b][size=4]Emerald Arrow / Bolt[/size][/b]
A steel tipped arrow / bolt with an embedded emerald.

Restores 25% of the damage done as stamina.

[b][size=4]Ruby Arrow / Bolt[/size][/b]
A steel tipped arrow / bolt with an embedded ruby.

Restores 10% of the damage done as health.

[b][size=4]Diamond Arrow / Bolt[/size][/b]
A steel tipped arrow / bolt with an embedded diamond.

The projectile will attempt to home in to a nearby enemy.

[/spoiler][/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/2HGoZsR.png[/img][size=3]
There are a couple unique weapons that can be found using the same method as the Galaxy Sword.

Secret Weapon #1:
Given while holding a holy ring in a certain spot within the desert.
[spoiler][size=4][b][Yoba's Divine Harp][/b][/size]
A bow-like harp that fires a random note with each strum.

[img]https://imgur.com/L4DkKFc.gif[/img]

The bow uses its own internal ammo, namely musical notes.

Each note has a different effect:
[list]
[*]Crotchet Note - Stuns monster for 1 second
[*]Quaver Note - Restores 5% of the damage done as health
[*]Double Quaver Note - Restores 10% of the damage done as health
[*]Semiquaver Note - Guaranteed critical hit
[*]Minim Note - Does standard damage
[/list]

Unlock Condition
[spoiler]Hold a Ring of Yoba between the three pillars within the desert.
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

Secret Weapon #2:
Given while holding something rusty and of dwarven origin within the desert.
[spoiler][size=4][b][Dwarven Repeating Crossbow][/b][/size]
An ancient dwarven crossbow capable of firing multiple bolts before needing to reload.

[img]https://imgur.com/ohvfaXb.gif[/img]

The crossbow holds up to 8 bolts in its rack and allows for rapid-fire shots.

Unlock Condition
[spoiler]Hold a Rusty Cog between the three pillars within the desert.
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
[/size]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/Archery/tree/development/StarterPack]available here[/url].
